title: 目標達成の後に・目指すは…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as Haru Urara is steadily gaining recognition and nearing the end of her classic year…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Let's go to that Arima Kinen race thing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen… A very high-profile race where participants are selected through a fan vote.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I heard both Spe and Grass are gonna be in it! They've been training super hard!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Sei said she's going too, so I wanna go too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure watching some top-class racers will have a positive impact on Haru Urara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Which is why…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're here to watch the passion-filled Arima Kinen today!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay! Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow! There's so many people here! I can't believe Spe and the others get to run here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week and Grass Wonder are both among this year's most-watched Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And a bunch of older Umamusume are racing too! It must be so cool to race alongside them!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oooh, I'm so excited! I hope it starts soon! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The racers walk out onto the track.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, they're here! HEY, SPE!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Spe's face… It looks way different from usual.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: She looks kinda scary. But this is her big day… I wonder what she's upset about?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Nervous? Huh? Why?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: But I hope she can do her best! You've got this, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, the Arima Kinen begins!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The results are in folks! The winner is… Grass Wonder! Grass Wonder has won!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Special Week loses by a hair! The gold just barely escaped her grasp!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant… pant…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I was so close! Just half a step more and…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hnngh… Urrrgh…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That was an excellent race, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: …I planned on winning in a much more decisive fashion. Frankly, I'm not satisfied with this result.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I… I'm not satisfied either! Next time, I'm gonna beat you for sure!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Heh… I look forward to seeing you try. I'll see you again next year.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You can count on it!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wowie, wow, wow! That was so amazing!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Spe and Grass were so cool!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: My heart is pounding! I wonder why?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week and Grass Wonder put on an amazing performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Watching their race has opened Haru Urara's eyes. Maybe now, she'll finally…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh, I get it! It's because it's the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm sure it's super fun to run in the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: That's why my heart is beating so fast! Okay, I've decided!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna enter the Arima Kinen too!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Did I hear Haru Urara say she's gonna enter the Arima Kinen just now?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: What? Seriously? There's no way she could get in…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following Haru Urara's declaration, I can hear the audience's confused voices getting louder and louder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I should be happy she's decided on a goal… but what a difficult goal it is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, if she's dead set on it, I have to support her all the way!
choice_data_list: It'll be a long and hard road. Can you handle it?
It'll be a long and hard road. Can you handle it?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm no quitter!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Woo! Hahaha! See? I'm super pumped!
choice_data_list: You have to do well in a lot of races too, you know?
You have to do well in a lot of races too, you know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If Haru Urara wants to enter the Arima Kinen, she'll first have to prove that she's got what it takes by placing high in graded races.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Well, you'll help me, right? I'll run a bunch, so we'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heehee. I can't wait for next year's Arima Kinen! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …I'm going to believe in Haru Urara's resolve. Now that she's set her sights on a big goal, she can move on from her classic year.
